name: motd-project
description: MOTD (Mukhawar of the Day) — UAE/GCC hybrid marketplace for ready-made clothes and custom tailoring

scripts.dev: node api.js && concurrently "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.dev:backend: node api.js && npm run dev --prefix backend
scripts.dev:frontend: node api.js && npm run dev --prefix frontend
scripts.install:all: npm install --ignore-scripts && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.build: node api.js && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.start: node api.js && npm run start --prefix backend
